preconditions.description: The length n of string s is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.
The integer k is between 1 and n inclusive.
The length of s is a multiple of k.
s is a string and k is an integer.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n/k lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) <= k for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line has length at most k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line)) == len(line) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains only distinct characters.

postconditions.expression: all(all(s[i*k + j] in line for j, line in enumerate(stdout.strip().splitlines()) if s[i*k + j] in line) for i in range(len(s)//k))
postconditions.description: Each character in an output line appears in the corresponding substring of s.

postconditions.expression: all(list(line) == [c for c in s[i*k:i*k+k] if c not in line[:line.index(c)] if c in line] for i, line in enumerate(stdout.strip().splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the subsequence of the corresponding substring formed by keeping the first occurrence of each character and removing subsequent duplicates, preserving original order.
